rule: A field is listed only when its result schema defines it as build identity, run identity or timing, never a computed value. Paths: $.a.b[*].c is one field (array indices collapsed); **.a.b is that tail at any depth. Key names compare ignoring case. A $.tables.<t>[*].<c> path also masks CSV column <c>; a $.summary.<k> path also masks key <k> of a key,value CSV.

documents.note: stability --events-out summary (RmsEventsExport.SummaryJsonText): case label, frequency, step, duration, events, verdict, machine list and provenance tag. Every field is an input or a computed value; none is identity or timing.
stability --export (the classical trajectory): label, frequency, step, machines, reduced admittance and samples. No identity or timing field.

The dynamics-study result has no schema tag (schemaVersion 1). Its one identity field, provenance.engine, is masked by **.provenance.engine above; its provenance hashes (studySha256, inputs, modelAssignments, plugins) are compared, and a differing one makes the entry CANNOT-REPLAY (indirect input changed).
long-term --out CSV (LongTermResult.ToCsv): one row per step, no comment lines, no identity or timing column.
trip --export CSV (dtm,f): times from the fixed epoch 2000-01-01, not the clock. No identity or timing column.
modal --export (SmallSignalExport): label, model and modes. No identity or timing field.
